column1: #  - only forms at the top level of the file count; a defun inside a function body, when, progn or eval-and-compile is not held;

#  - defun, defsubst and defmacro are functions (macros are functions), and so are define-inline, cl-defun, cl-defmacro, cl-defgeneric, (defalias 'name ..), define-minor-mode, define-derived-mode and define-globalized-minor-mode;
#  - cl-defmethod is a method, named by its generic function;
#  - defvar, defvar-local, defcustom and defface are variables, defconst is a constant; a bare (defvar x) only declares the name and is not a definition;
#  - cl-defstruct (name or (name options)) and defclass are classes;
#  - defgroup, define-error, require, provide, setq and calls are not definitions.
